mission.heading: THE CURSED HUNTER
paras: Valdrenn lies under fog and old debts, where monsters are hunted for coin.
Torin Vael killed the Marsh Stag, and its dying breath cursed him. A black thorn now climbs toward his heart.
You are Torin, with the witch Mirelle at your side. Find who sent you to that hunt and break the curse before the moon rises. You have seven minutes.

tutorial.title: Look around
tutorial.text: Drag the screen to turn around. Tap anything that looks useful.

tutorial.title: Your goal
tutorial.text: This line tells you what to do right now.

tutorial.title: The clock
tutorial.text: You have 7 minutes to break the curse. The clock stops while Torin and Mirelle talk.

tutorial.title: Crowns
tutorial.text: Crowns are your score. A wrong answer or a hint costs Crowns.

tutorial.title: Casebook
tutorial.text: Everything you find is saved here. Open it when you need a clue.

tutorial.title: Hints
tutorial.text: Stuck? Tap Hint. You get 3 hints in the whole game.

tutorial.title: Pause
tutorial.text: Pause stops the clock. Every puzzle also has an X to close it.

opening.text: Three days ago the Marsh Stag fell to a hunter's blade.
Tonight the hunter pays for it.
Torin, your neck. The mark moved again.
Then we had better move faster. The Last Lantern Inn is the nearest roof.

idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

rooms.name: The Last Lantern Inn
rooms.objective: Find who ordered the hunt. Open the cellar.

enter.text: Seven minutes. A dead man's clock, and I still smell wet dog.
That is the rain, Torin. Stop sulking and look at the walls.

discuss.text: Somebody wanted that Stag dead. Bounties do not post themselves.

right.text: The door groans open. Below, the cellar smells of old paper and older secrets.
Contract, signed with a crane's head. I never saw that seal on a hunt before.

wrong.text: That order feels wrong, Torin. Which warning came first?
Look at the dates printed on each notice, not the marks.
Earliest date first. Crow, then the next oldest, and so on.

hints.text: Some notices hide ink. Sweep the light slowly.
The ledger says the oldest warning is answered first.
Read the four dates. Put them in order, earliest first.

hotspots.name: Hooked lantern
hotspots.text: A hooked lantern. Its light can show ink that you cannot see in the dark.

hotspots.name: Tavern ledger
hotspots.text: The innkeeper's ledger. It says warnings must be answered in order. The oldest warning is answered first.
hotspots.clue: Tavern ledger: the oldest warning is answered first.
hotspots.blocked: It is too dark to read the ledger. You need some light.

hotspots.name: Antler trophy

views.text: An antler trophy hangs on the beam. The base looks strange.
Turned over, the base has a thorn carved inside it. Someone marked this place.

secret.text: A thorn is carved inside the trophy base. The thorn is the sign of the Stag contract.
secret.clue: A thorn is carved inside the antler trophy base.

hotspots.blocked: It is too dark to see the trophy. You need some light.

hotspots.name: Contract Page
hotspots.text: The Marsh Stag contract. It is signed with a crane's head seal. Page 1 of 6 is yours.

enter.text: Silver eyes and a bad sunset on your chest. Sit, hunter. I have seen that thorn.
Can you slow it? We have until moonrise.

discuss.text: Four measures of marsh water, and my hands are too shaky to count.

right.text: The antidote hisses green. The thorn stops, just for now.
A steward paid for that hunt in coin stamped with a crane. Ask who sits behind the crane.

wrong.text: Not four yet. Count what is in the big vial.
You can pour between the vials, not just fill and empty.
Fill the big one, pour into the small one, and think about what is left.

hints.text: Only the big vial needs to end with four.
Fill the big vial first, then pour into the small one.
Empty the small one, pour the leftover into it, refill, and top it up.

hotspots.name: Recipe slate
hotspots.text: A recipe is chalked on the slate. The antidote needs exactly four measures of marsh water.
hotspots.clue: Recipe slate: the antidote needs exactly four measures of marsh water.

hotspots.name: Empty antidote flask
hotspots.text: An empty antidote flask. Wenna will need it once the water is measured.

hotspots.name: Thorn-leaf bundle
hotspots.text: A bundle of dried thorn leaves. This is the herb that fights the curse.

views.text: Thick soot lines the cauldron rim. Something glints in it.
Rubbed clean, the soot shows a coin stamped with a crane's head.

secret.text: A coin stamped with a crane's head lies in the ash. Someone powerful paid for this hunt.
secret.clue: A crane-stamped coin was hidden in Wenna's ash.

hotspots.name: Wenna's Account
hotspots.text: Wenna wrote down what she knows. Page 2 of 6 is yours.

onSolve.toast: Your flask fills with green antidote.

enter.text: Cold. Even for me. Something died here, and it did not rest.
The prints end at the altar. It came here to pray, or to hide.

discuss.text: Three coloured glasses and one riddle. Somebody wanted this read slowly.

right.text: A crown, a chalice, a stag. A tale told in three colours.
The Stag was the Prince. We hunted a murdered man.

wrong.text: The colours matter. What does the plaque say comes first?
Wound, water, wild. Match each to a lens colour.
Red first, then blue, then green. Read what each lens shows.

hints.text: Each lens shows a different picture on the wall.
The plaque names three things. Each one is a colour.
Red, then blue, then green. Place what you saw, in that order.

hotspots.name: Altar plaque
hotspots.goal: Find the plaque and read it.
hotspots.text: First the wound, then the water, then the wild. The plaque adds: wound is red, water is blue, wild is green.
hotspots.clue: Plaque: first the wound, then the water, then the wild.
notes: Wound = red. Water = blue. Wild = green. Use them in that order.

hotspots.name: Red lens
hotspots.text: A red glass lens in a brass ring.

hotspots.name: Blue lens
hotspots.text: A blue glass lens in a brass ring.

hotspots.name: Green lens
hotspots.text: A green glass lens in a brass ring.

views.text: A cracked stone font with a chalice carved on it.
Under the chalice rim, someone scratched the letters A.V.

secret.text: The initials A.V. are scratched under the chalice rim. They belong to Prince Aldric Valdrenn.
secret.clue: The initials A.V. belong to Prince Aldric Valdrenn.

hotspots.name: The Prince's Vow
hotspots.text: A vow signed A.V. Page 3 of 6 is yours.

rooms.name: The Hunters' Bestiary Tower
rooms.objective: Find the beast that fears everything.

enter.text: My guild's tower. I swore I would not come back.
You swore a lot of things. Start reading the stands.

discuss.text: Eight beasts, three weaknesses. One of them is weak to everything.

right.text: The cabinet opens. Dark filings glitter in a stone dish.
Crane paid for silver-eyed hunters on purpose. He wanted a man who could not be bought off.

wrong.text: Check that beast's stand again. What hurts it?
A beast with two weaknesses sits where two circles overlap.
One beast is weak to silver, fire and salt. That one sits in the very middle.

hints.text: Read every stand. Each beast lists what hurts it.
Two weaknesses means the overlap of two circles.
Three weaknesses is the centre. None means outside the circles.

hotspots.name: Bestiary index
hotspots.text: The index lists eight beasts. Each one has a stand in this room that says what hurts it.

hotspots.name: Stand: Fenwolf
hotspots.text: Fenwolf. Weak to: Silver.

hotspots.name: Stand: Reed Drowner
hotspots.text: Reed Drowner. Weak to: Fire.
hotspots.clue: Reed Drowner is weak to fire.

hotspots.name: Stand: Salt Shade
hotspots.text: Salt Shade. Weak to: Salt.
hotspots.clue: Salt Shade is weak to salt.

hotspots.name: Stand: Gloam Wraith
hotspots.text: Gloam Wraith. Weak to: Silver and Salt.
hotspots.clue: Gloam Wraith is weak to silver and salt.

hotspots.name: Stand: Thorn Hag
hotspots.text: Thorn Hag. Weak to: Silver and Fire.
hotspots.clue: Thorn Hag is weak to silver and fire.

hotspots.name: Stand: Mire Ghoul
hotspots.text: Mire Ghoul. Weak to: Fire and Salt.
hotspots.clue: Mire Ghoul is weak to fire and salt.

hotspots.name: Stand: Grave Warden
hotspots.text: Grave Warden. Weak to: Silver, Fire and Salt.
hotspots.clue: Grave Warden is weak to silver, fire and salt.

hotspots.name: Stand: Plain Brute
hotspots.text: Plain Brute. Weak to: nothing. Steel just works on it.

views.text: A huge horned skull on a high shelf. Something is tucked inside.
A folded guild note is tucked inside. It says Crane's steward pays for the hunt.

secret.text: A guild note ties the hunt's sponsor to Magistrate Crane.
secret.clue: A guild note ties the hunt's sponsor to Magistrate Crane.

hotspots.name: Grave-iron filings
hotspots.text: Dark grave-iron filings. They help break binding curses.

hotspots.name: Hunter's Ledger
hotspots.text: The guild's own ledger. Page 4 of 6 is yours.

enter.text: There. One yew in all that marsh. Too neat to be natural.
A grave marker. Somebody planted it to be found.

discuss.text: Two posts, two bearings. Where the lines meet, that is where he lies.

right.text: Where the lines cross, the yew stands. Beneath it, a ring catches the dying light.
A crane stamped over the Prince's own crest. The Magistrate marked his work.

wrong.text: That is not where the two lines cross.
Draw both lines. Mark where they meet, not where one passes.
Both bearings run at 45 degrees. Use the middle of the map.

hints.text: Use the compass at each post, then draw each line on the map.
Post A is at B2, Post B is at H2.
One line rises to the right, the other rises to the left. They cross in the centre column.

hotspots.name: Brass compass
hotspots.text: A brass compass. Hold it when you read a signal post.

hotspots.name: Spyglass
hotspots.text: A brass spyglass. It lets you see the yew from far away.

hotspots.name: Carved flag post

views.text: An old wooden post holds a torn flag. Something is carved low on it.
Carved low on the post: A.V. wait for me.

secret.text: The carving says: A.V. wait for me. The Prince hoped someone would come.
secret.clue: A carving says: A.V. wait for me.

hotspots.blocked: Marks are cut into the post, but you cannot read their angle without something to measure with.

hotspots.name: Post A (west)
hotspots.goal: Take a bearing to the first post.
hotspots.text: You hold the compass and look through the spyglass. From Post A, the yew lies at 045 degrees (north-east).
hotspots.clue: From Post A the yew lies at 045 degrees.
notes: Post A is at B2. Bearing to the yew: 045 degrees (north-east).

hotspots.name: Post B (east)
hotspots.goal: Take a bearing to the second post.
hotspots.text: You hold the compass and look through the spyglass. From Post B, the yew lies at 315 degrees (north-west).
hotspots.clue: From Post B the yew lies at 315 degrees.
notes: Post B is at H2. Bearing to the yew: 315 degrees (north-west).

hotspots.name: Map
hotspots.goal: Mark where the two lines cross.

hotspots.name: The Prince's Ring
hotspots.text: The Prince's ring, buried under the yew. It has a second, newer stamp: a crane's head. Page 5 of 6 is yours.

enter.text: Chains of binding. Whoever wove these knew a good deal of dark craft.
Then they know what the Stag was. And they sent me to kill it.

discuss.text: Free the chains without crossing them. A curse needs a knot to hold.

right.text: The last chain slides free. The sarcophagus lid splits and a letter drifts out.
Crane. He poisoned him, bound him, and hired me to bury it.

wrong.text: Some chains still cross. Look for the red glow.
Try the inner three rings first. They form a small triangle.
Put the inner triangle inside the outer triangle. Then no chains cross.

hints.text: Red chains are the ones still crossing.
Rings 1, 2 and 3 form one triangle. Rings 4, 5 and 6 form another.
Draw one triangle inside the other. Each inner ring sits under one outer ring.

hotspots.name: Iron hook
hotspots.text: A wrought iron hook. It helps you move the heavy chain rings.

hotspots.name: Sarcophagus lid

views.text: The stone lid is bound with cursed chains.
A stag's antlers are carved into the stone, hidden under the chains.

secret.text: A stag's antlers are carved on the lid. The one inside was the Stag.
secret.clue: A stag's antlers are carved on the sarcophagus lid.

hotspots.blocked: Heavy chains hold the lid down. You need something to hook them with.

hotspots.name: The six rings
hotspots.goal: Free the chains so none cross.

hotspots.name: Blue brazier
hotspots.text: The brazier flares bright. Its light shows a small stone coffer beside it.
hotspots.toast: A coffer shows in the light.

hotspots.name: The Prince's Letter
hotspots.text: The Prince's letter. Page 6 of 6 is yours.

rooms.name: The Ritual Ring
rooms.objective: Stand where the stones frame the dip in the mountain.

enter.text: The stones. Seven of them. And Crane is already here.
Hunter. You are a good deal faster than I hoped.

discuss.text: You hired me to kill a dead man. I am done being your blade.

right.text: Thank you for finding me. I only wished to be remembered.

choice.text: The Thorn Seal burns in its bowl. The curse waits for a name.

vision: A vision flickers over the stones...
Magistrate Crane stands in the old hall, smiling.
He pours poison into the Prince's chalice, and the Prince drinks.
The Prince falls. A thorn grows. The Stag is born.

wrong.text: That gap between the stones is a trick. The real one is the V-shaped dip in the far mountain.
Look for the full moon. The dip is right under it.
Put the dip inside the ring, then hold still.

hints.text: The letter said to stand where the stones frame the dip in the mountain.
Gaps between the other stones are tricks. The real dip is in the far mountain, under the moon.
Turn until the V-shaped dip sits inside the ring. Then hold still for three seconds.

hotspots.name: Centre of the ring
hotspots.goal: Step into the centre of the ring.

hotspots.name: Thorn Seal
hotspots.text: The Thorn Seal. It holds the curse. Open the Casebook, tap it to hold it, then tap the bowl on the altar.

pages.title: Page 1: The Contract
pages.text: A hunt contract for the Marsh Stag. It is signed with a crane's head. A steward's wax seal presses the same crane into the red wax.

pages.title: Page 2: Wenna's Account
pages.text: Wenna writes: a steward paid for the Stag hunt in coin stamped with a crane. The Stag was never an ordinary beast.

pages.title: Page 3: The Prince's Vow
pages.text: A vow signed A.V. Prince Aldric Valdrenn swears to guard the marsh people. The sigils are his: a Crown, a Chalice and a Stag.

pages.title: Page 4: The Hunter's Ledger
pages.text: The guild ledger shows who paid for the hunt. The buyer asked for one thing only: send a hunter with silver eyes.

pages.title: Page 5: The Prince's Ring
pages.text: The Prince's gold ring. A newer stamp covers his crest: a crane's head. Crane marked his own work.

pages.title: Page 6: The Prince's Letter
pages.text: Aldric writes: Crane poisoned me for the crown and bound my spirit as a beast. If you read this, go to the Ritual Ring. Stand where the two gate stones frame the notch in the far mountain.

choices.title: Return the curse to Crane
choices.text: The thorn leaves you and takes root in the Magistrate. He becomes the thing he made.

choices.title: Bear the curse yourself
choices.text: You pull the thorn into your own heart so the Prince can rest. The mark stays, but slowly.

choices.title: Break the curse
choices.text: The antidote, the grave-iron and the Prince's ring unbind everything. Aldric is freed.

return.title: Dark Justice
lines: Crane screams as antlers split his brow. The thorn takes root in him.
Guards close in. The kingdom is safe.
Torin walks into the fog, free but cold.
The kingdom was saved. The hunter kept the silence.

bear.title: The Heroic Sacrifice
lines: The Prince bows to Torin and fades.
Torin looks at the thorn, grim and steady. It will climb slowly now.
Mirelle takes his arm. He lives, cursed, but not alone.

breakFull.title: The Curse Is Broken
lines: The thorn dissolves into gold light.
Aldric's spirit rises into the dawn.
Torin's silver eyes grow warm. The marsh is quiet at last.

breakBitter.title: A Bittersweet Dawn
lines: The thorn dissolves into gold light.
Aldric's spirit rises into the dawn.
But a dark scar remains on Torin's neck, to remember the cost.

seed: In the bowl, the Thorn Seal burns away. Its ash leaves a map to Ashmark, another kingdom under the same curse.
Torin, Mirelle and the seal's ash start walking.
